create_adversarial_loss: create an AdversarialLoss instance with an adversary module, optimizer, and loss function for GAN training
train_adversary_with_fake_real: train the adversary discriminator using fake and real sample tensors via the train_adv method
compute_generator_loss: compute the generator adversarial loss by calling forward on the AdversarialLoss with fake samples
save_adversarial_loss_state: save the AdversarialLoss state dict including the embedded optimizer state via _save_to_state_dict
load_adversarial_loss_state: load the AdversarialLoss state dict and restore the embedded optimizer state via _load_from_state_dict
